description.text: The fourth and last expansion pack of the ADV series, released on 16 January 2004. Its theme is the ancient past, led by Regice, Regirock and Registeel, with an Exploud that knows four attacks, a Castform with an unusual Poké-Power, and more Pokémon ex. The cards are numbered to 83. In English it became EX Hidden Legends in June 2004.
